newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat futures end lower after midday rise.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat futures end lower after midday rise.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures closed lower after light speculative long liquidation erased midday gains.

Traders said it appeared much of the late selling was by firms that bought futures during Friday's rally. The late selling may have been motivated by limit declines in CBOT soybeans and a late drop in CBOT corn futures.

CBOT corn and soybeans were lower throughout the day in reaction to bearish USDA crop data but declines were extended late. The USDA data was neutral to bullish for wheat but with corn and soybeans lower and forecasts for active wheat planting this week, traders said it was difficult for gains to hold.

USDA cut its U.S. wheat production estimate to 2.282 billion bushels from 2.296 billion in September and revised downward its 1996/97 ending stocks estimate to 470 million from 506 million in September.
KCBT wheat closed down 2-1/2 to 4-1/2 cents a bushel with December off 2-1/2 at $4.35-1/2 per bushel.
